delivery_evidence: TEEM 'implemented through face-to-face, small-group teacher trainings ... combined with in-classroom coaching': a 2-day initial training, fourteen ~2-hr in-class coaching sessions (biweekly), and weekly face-to-face sessions; a web-based course platform is used as a tool DURING the in-person sessions, not for remote delivery (p.41-43 intervention description).
test_alignment_evidence: Extracted child outcomes are all standardized norm-referenced tests (TOPEL Print Knowledge, TOPEL Phonological Awareness, and a language composite of EOWPVT/PLS-4/TOPEL Definitional Vocabulary) not tailored to TEEM content; all test_type=standardized_independent (Table 5, p.47).
curriculum_evidence: TEEM is a comprehensive classroom instructional model with structured whole/small-group cognitive activities, progress-monitoring assessments, and provided instructional materials (Lakeshore 'Ready to Read Toolkit') that teachers implement (Methods, p.41-42).
outcome_timing_evidence: Child outcomes measured at spring posttest at the end of the treatment school year via ANCOVA on posttest controlling for pretest; no post-year follow-up (Table 5, p.47; extraction timepoint 'posttest, spring, end of treatment year').
